originality.rationale: Gubarev–Kozlov (2023), Proposition 2.5 already classifies the two complex conjugacy types of splitting weight-one Rota–Baxter operators on sl2; these imply the geometric classes for idempotent Nijenhuis projections and are expressly credited. Over odd finite fields the nonzero complex class has two distinct rational square classes, giving three rational orbits per nontrivial rank with exact sizes and population. The 2024 Zhikhareva result treats regular three-distinct-eigenvalue Nijenhuis operators over real/complex fields. Related results on Heisenberg and almost-abelian Lie algebras concern solvable objects. No searched prior result states or implies the full finite-field rational orbit census without additional arithmetic descent. Historical classical-factorization priority risk remains.
